{"url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pulls/22515","id":4912520086,"node_id":"PR_kwDOAORW-88AAAABJM8blg","html_url":"https://github.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pull/22515","diff_url":"https://github.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pull/22515.diff","patch_url":"https://github.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pull/22515.patch","issue_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/issues/22515","commits_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pulls/22515/commits","review_comments_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pulls/22515/comments","review_comment_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pulls/comments{/number}","comments_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/issues/22515/comments","statuses_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/statuses/dea481caeb81e0abb88fbfb832f0bab8ae8f0eb7","number":22515,"state":"open","locked":false,"title":"Win32: do not stretch the DXGI swap chain while a window is resized","user":{"login":"fmiratsch","id":29370932,"node_id":"MDQ6VXNlcjI5MzcwOTMy","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/29370932?v=4","gravatar_id":"","url":"https://api.github.com/users/fmiratsch","html_url":"https://github.com/fmiratsch","followers_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fmiratsch/followers","following_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fmiratsch/following{/other_user}","gists_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fmiratsch/gists{/gist_id}","starred_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fmiratsch/starred{/owner}{/repo}","subscriptions_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fmiratsch/subscriptions","organizations_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fmiratsch/orgs","repos_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fmiratsch/repos","events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fmiratsch/events{/privacy}","received_events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fmiratsch/received_events","type":"User","user_view_type":"public","site_admin":false},"body":"## What does the pull request do?

Stops the low-latency DXGI swap chain (`Win32CompositionMode.LowLatencyDxgiSwapChain`) from showing stretched, blurred frames while a window is resized:

- the swap chain is created with `DXGI_SCALING_NONE` instead of the default `DXGI_SCALING_STRETCH`;
- its buffers take the size of the frame being drawn (`RenderTargetSceneInfo.Size`) instead of the window's current client rect (this resolves the `// TODO: use expectedPixelSize` in `DxgiRenderTarget.BeginDrawCore`);
- the swap chain's background color (`IDXGISwapChain1::SetBackgroundColor`) follows the top level's background when it is a single opaque color, so the area a buffer of the previous size leaves uncovered matches the window instead of being black.

## What is the current behavior?

Between `WM_SIZE` and the next present, DWM composes the window with the old buffer stretched to the new client size. The whole window content (text included) is blurred and shifted by a few pixels for a frame, then sharp again: an A-B-A flicker while dragging the window border.

A second artifact: `BeginDrawCore` sizes the buffer from `GetClientRect` on the render thread, while the compositor draws the frame at the size it got from the UI thread. During a resize the window runs ahead of the frame, so the buffer is a few pixels larger than what is drawn and the undrawn strip along its right/bottom edge shows black.

Measured on Windows 11 with Desktop Duplication (dxcam, 120 frames/s), dragging the bottom-right corner by +380/+200 px in 4 s through `SendInput`, a maximal-content window (a data grid filling the client area):

| Build | Frames | Stretched/blurred frames | Frames with a black strip |
|---|---|---|---|
| before | ~235 | 27 | 10 |
| `DXGI_SCALING_NONE` only | ~240 | 0 | 40 |
| + background color | 251 | 0 | 8 (about 4 px at the right edge) |
| + buffer at frame size, color from an environment variable | 242 | 0 | 1 |
| this PR (color from `TopLevel.Background`) | 215 | 0 | 0 |

`Win32CompositionMode.RedirectionSurface` on the same machine: no stretched frames, 2 frames with a black strip.

## What is the updated/expected behavior with this PR?

No stretched frames while resizing. A buffer that does not match the window yet is shown unscaled at the top left; the uncovered area shows the window's background color.

## How was the solution implemented (if it's not obvious)?

- `DxgiRenderTarget`: `Scaling = DXGI_SCALING_NONE`; `ResizeBuffers` and the EGL surface use `sceneInfo.Size` (falling back to the window size when it is empty); `SetBackgroundColor` is called when the scene's background color changes.
- The background travels with the scene, like the transparency level: `CompositionTarget` has a `BackgroundColor` property, `TopLevel` sets it from an opaque `ISolidColorBrush` background (transparent otherwise), and `RenderTargetSceneInfo.BackgroundColor` hands it to the render target with each frame. Transparent keeps the previous behavior (black).

## Checked / not checked

- Avalonia.Win32 builds (net8.0, net10.0). The measurements above were made with the same changes applied to 12.1.0; the last row is this change with the color taken from the window's background. The measurements have not been repeated after moving the color into the scene info.
- Not checked: other composition modes (they do not use `DxgiRenderTarget`).
- A brush whose `Color` is changed in place (without assigning a new brush) is not followed; theme resources replace the brush.

## Checklist

- [ ] Added unit tests (if possible)? Not added: needs a real swap chain and DWM.
- [x] Added XML documentation to any related classes?

## Breaking changes

None. `RenderTargetSceneInfo` gets an optional trailing parameter (`IRenderTarget` is `[PrivateApi]`); `CompositionTarget` is internal.
